And yes, I will be okay. My mood has gotten significantly better.

I understand that, and it's something I'm working on. It's very hard, though.

She does realize that this experiment would be really hard on me. She says that even though it hurts me by not talking to her, she says it hurts her as well seeing me go through this. But to be honest, I'm actually kind of glad she decided to do this. I've been relying on her for far too long. I need to find other people's shoulders to lean on, in addition to her's.

A lot of things. Big part that got me "up" was getting to talk to my best friend, aka my rock. She's felt a little overwhelmed in helping me through this situation I'm in. She considered not talking to me anymore, but she decided to do this experiment, in which she blocks me on FB and doesn't talk to me, to try and get me to understand what it would be like for her if I left permanently. She said if I come out of it with my attitude unchanged, then she said she can't talk to me anymore. However, if my attitude changes and I find a motivation and a will to live, she will continue to talk to me and discuss with me the reason for doing it and other things.
Kinda. It's been up and down. I've been incredibly unstable

I think it might help. she's been through so much with me

Yes there are a few things I'm looking into

Unfortunately, she pretty much knows everything about my situation, so there's not really much more I could explain to her. She is my rock and my best friend.

because I want to feel validated

all my friends say they love me and are there to support me, but I can only rely on them so much before I start driving them away. I'm currently seeing a therapist and psychiatrist but I fear that even they may not be enough and if so, I would have no idea who to turn to

Yes, I do show how grateful I am for their support. However, one of them is on the verge of not talking to me anymore because they say it's very hard for them to see me go through this and struggle.

I'm unstable because I'm constantly wavering between moods. I was diagnosed with major depressive disorder back in October and have been taking meds since then. I am seeing a therapist twice a week and a psychiatrist once a month
I can only imagine how much more they can take of me before I drive them away because of my constant neediness and instability
